messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime.queue_depth_pct > 0.95 across us-west-2 for /v1/generate. auto-escalation: oncall.
incident-bot: top signals: median_latency_p95 up 3x, inflight_count spike, queue_drop_rate rising. links: https://metrics.company/alerts/5290012345
samira (oncall): on it. paging standby. starting triage now. can someone grab customer-impact and runbook? :eyes:
kai (runtime): I can take runtime mitigations. first-pass: lower max_inflight for best-effort tenants, enable soft-shedding for embedding routes, increase per-request timeout to avoid tail retries.
mike-sre: I'll check infra (GPU/host) saturation and autoscaler logs. ETA 3m.
jess-prodeng: Heads-up: a handful of enterprise customers are on dedicated pools in us-west-2. We should avoid blanket quota drops for them — suggest target non-enterprise tenant IDs. Listing affected high-volume tenants now.
tanvi-support: Customer Slack pings: two PLG customers reporting timeouts. No escalations to CS yet.
samira (oncall): ok plan: (1) runtime: set max_inflight global to 6 -> 3 for best-effort tenants, keep enterprise at 8. (2) apply route-level rate-limit to /v1/embeddings: 60r/s burst 120. (3) enable soft-shed flag for non-critical features (autocomplete telemetry). (4) increase request timeout from 30s -> 45s for routed queue (to reduce retry flurry).
kai (runtime): executing step 1/3. running config patch: ```
PATCH /config/runtime
{"overrides": [{"tenant_selector": "tier==\"best-effort\"", "max_inflight": 3}, {"tenant_selector": "tier==\"enterprise\"", "max_inflight": 8}]}
```
kai (runtime): applied to us-west-2 canary (hosts: runtime-uw2-canary-2). Observing queue depth.
mike-sre: autoscaler shows PGPU nodes at 82% mem, 78% sm utilization. Not a hard infra outage. Looks like request storm + cache misses.
jess-prodeng: I pushed a targeted quota bump for tenant t-42 (trial) to avoid 429s while we stabilize. Others left untouched.
tanvi-support: Notifying customers of transient degradation and mitigation steps. (sent message to two PLG customers) :email:
samira (oncall): enabling soft-shed now for telemetry endpoints. command: ```
POST /runtime/feature-toggle
{"feature":"telemetry-log", "mode":"soft-shed", "scope":"non-enterprise", "region":"us-west-2"}
```
kai (runtime): soft-shed toggle on. telemetry ingestion now returns 202 + shed_reason. Latency on core generation route dropping.
incident-bot: NOTIFICATION: queue_depth_pct decreased to 0.66 in us-west-2 after mitigations. p95 latency trending down.
samira (oncall): great. moving to step: tune timeouts and rate-limits for another 10m then reassess. If stable, we will roll back best-effort max_inflight to previous after 30m.
mike-sre: started a short-term inflight cap metric dashboard and a trigger to alert if queue_depth_pct > 0.8 again.
jess-prodeng: flagged a post-incident action: improve prefix-KV cache warmup for heavy tenants to avoid cache-miss storm.
tanvi-support: customers acknowledged — one wants a follow-up RCA. I'll collect logs and affected request ids.
samira (oncall): thanks all. define ownership for RCA: kai runtime for mitigation timeline + config diff, mike-sre infra for autoscaler behavior, jess-prodeng for customer impact list, tanvi for customer comms. I'll start the incident doc.
incident-bot: INCIDENT MODE: triage -> monitoring. incident record created: INC-2026-07-11-5290012345
samira (oncall): closing Slack triage thread, will post updates in incident doc and ping when we decide permanent config change. :white_check_mark:
